category_title: Students with skill/ability deficits in controlling anger and bullying behaviors
scenario_title: Addressing physical and verbal aggression in the after-school program
minimal_context: Amy and a staff member are sitting together to complete behavioral reflection worksheets during a pull-out session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to complete this 'Thinking about My Behavior' worksheet about what happened yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do it. I've been 'getting in trouble' for as long as I can remember, and this won't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just answer the first question on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I already told you what happened. I felt out of control and I got angry.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Write that down on the 'Understanding Feelings Can Affect My Behavior' page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said I'm not doing it! You better leave me alone or I'll hit you, just like I hit that kid in the after-school program!
